3.comment: RCWL-1601 shown (3–5 V, HC-SR04 compatible). An HC-SR04P looks like the classic blue HC-SR04.

4.comment: Similar, not the same: our own 3-channel TCRT5000 board (same 60 × 24 mm size and sensors). Buy the module described in column D; it must have ANALOG outputs.

5.comment: MG90D shown (Adafruit's metal-gear micro servo). The MG90S is the same size, horns and mounting.

8.comment: Shown: 3- and 4-cell holders. Buy a 3 × 18650 holder (about 61.6 × 78.4 mm) and wire it in PARALLEL (1S3P).

9.comment: Similar, not the same: a TP4056 charger board whose right half (DW01 + 8205A, B+/B−/OUT+/OUT−) is the protection circuit. Buy the protection-only board; the controller already charges the battery.

10.comment: Board side shown: the male XT30 on the controller. Buy the FEMALE XT30U-F with leads, which plugs into it.
